<thought>All spectral data (mass, 13C NMR, 1H NMR) are consistent with a molecule C₁₆H₁₆O containing a ketone carbonyl, an acetyl methyl, a –CH₂–CH₂– side chain, and two aromatic rings (one para‑substituted). The validated SMILES that fits this description is CC(=O)c1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)c1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2</final_answer>
